result.instructions: Tools for Nash, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which deliveries are still in transit today, and which couriers have them?"; "Show me the orders created in the last 24 hours that have no delivery yet."; "Get the status and courier of the delivery with external identifier order-4f2a.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Nash data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run nash_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run nash_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run nash_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. nash_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: nash_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List and search Nash orders (pre-dispatch delivery requests) with filters, sorting and pagination. Returns a slim payload; use nash_get_order for full details. Nash API: GET /v1/orders.

endDate.description: End date-time, ISO 8601 (default 7 days from now).

tools.name: nash_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one Nash order by id: pickup and dropoff details, status, quotes and metadata. Nash API: GET /v1/order/{id}.

tools.name: nash_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List and search Nash jobs (deliveries) by date, delivery status, provider, courier or text, with pagination. Returns a slim payload; use nash_get_job for details. Nash API: GET /v1/jobs.

sortBy.description: Sort field, e.g. created_at or pickup_start_time.

endDate.description: End date-time, ISO 8601 (default 7 days from now).

shortReferenceCode.description: Short reference code of the job.

tools.name: nash_get_job
tools.title: Get a job
tools.description: Get one Nash job (delivery) by id: tasks, courier, status timeline and tracking data. Nash API: GET /v1/jobs/{id}.

tools.name: nash_get_job_by_external_identifier
tools.title: Get a job by external identifier
tools.description: Get one Nash job by the external identifier your system set when it created the job. Nash API: GET /v1/jobs/external_identifier/{externalIdentifier}.

external_identifier.description: Your external identifier for the job.

annotations.title: Get a job by external identifier

tools.name: nash_list_providers
tools.title: List delivery providers
tools.description: List the delivery providers available to the organization (the couriers and fleets Nash can dispatch to). Nash API: GET /v1/providers.

tools.name: nash_list_routes
tools.title: List routes
tools.description: List and search multi-stop routes with filters, sorting and pagination. Use nash_get_route for stops and metrics. Nash API: GET /v1/routes.

endDate.description: End date-time, ISO 8601 (default 7 days from now).

isDispatched.description: true = only dispatched routes, false = only undispatched.

dispatchStrategyId.description: Only routes with this dispatch strategy id.

tools.name: nash_get_route
tools.title: Get a route
tools.description: Get one route by id: its stops, travel metrics and the orders on it. Nash API: GET /v1/routes/{id}.

tools.name: nash_list_zones
tools.title: List zones
tools.description: List the geographic delivery zones of the organization. Nash API: GET /v1/zones.

tools.name: nash_create_or_update_order
tools.title: Create or update an order
tools.description: Create a pre-dispatch Nash order, or update it when an order with the same externalId exists. It returns priced quotes from eligible providers. It does NOT dispatch a courier: dispatch is a separate step in Nash. Safe to retry with the same externalId. Nash API: POST /v1/order/external-identifier/{externalId}.

externalId.description: Your unique order id. Retries with the same id update one order.

pickupAddress.description: Pickup address in one line: number, street, city, state, zip, country.

dropoffAddress.description: Dropoff address in one line: number, street, city, state, zip, country.
